# Community Rule Column 7 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 7 | **Condition:** complete

---

**1** Whoever lies about property knowingly, they shall exclude him from the pure food of the Many for one year, and he shall be punished by reduction of

**2** one quarter of his food ration. Whoever answers his neighbor with obstinacy or speaks with impatience of

**3** spirit, thereby undermining the authority of his associate who is registered before him — his own hand has betrayed him; he shall be punished

**4** for one year. Whoever utters anything by the Name that is honored above all — whether he curses while stricken by

**5** distress or for any other reason, while reading the book or while blessing — he shall be separated and shall never return

**6** to the council of the community. If he spoke against one of the priests who are registered

**7** in the book while in anger, he shall be punished for one year and shall be set apart by himself from the pure food of

**8** the Many. But if he spoke inadvertently, he shall be punished for six months. Whoever deliberately

**9** lies shall be punished for six months. Whoever insults his neighbor without

**10** just cause shall be punished for one year and shall be excluded. Whoever speaks to his neighbor with deceit

**11** or knowingly wrongs him — his punishment is six months. If he acted negligently

**12** toward his neighbor — his punishment is three months. Whoever borrows from

**13** his neighbor's property without permission — his punishment is three months. Every man who bears a grudge

**14** against his neighbor without just cause shall be punished for six months. Likewise, whoever

**15** takes personal vengeance in any matter — his punishment is six months. Whoever speaks foolishly — three months. Whoever interrupts his neighbor's

**16** speech — ten days. Whoever lies down and sleeps during the session of

**17** the Many — thirty days. Likewise, whoever leaves the session of the Many without

**18** permission and without reason, up to three times in one session, shall be punished ten days. But if

**19** they are standing and he departs — thirty days. Whoever goes about naked before

**20** his neighbor without being compelled to do so — six months. The man who spits in the midst of the session of

**21** the Many — thirty days. Whoever extends his left hand to gesticulate

**22** with it — ten days. The man who slanders his neighbor

**23** shall be excluded from the pure food of the Many for one year and shall be punished. But the man who slanders

**24** the Many shall be expelled from among them and shall not return. The man who murmurs against

**25** the authority of the community shall be expelled and shall not return.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 7 contains the community's Penal Code. "The Many" (ha-rabbim) is retained as a technical term for the community assembly. Penalties range from ten days to permanent expulsion. The escalating severity reflects the community's emphasis on internal discipline and ritual purity.*
